Interface SDCScheduler

Scheduler
public interface SDCScheduler
Serves as wrapper for BukkitScheduler.

    • runTask

      void runTask(Consumer<SDCTask> consumer)
      Allows running a task as soon as possible (in sync) using a consumer. The benefit is that the task in the consumer can be used to cancel the task if needed.
      Parameters:
      consumer - the task to be run
